assert_is_instance_check_type: assert an object is an instance of a given class and raise TypeError if not
assert_is_instance_validate_return: validate and return an object after confirming it matches the expected class type
none_throws_guard_none: raise a ValueError if a value is None, otherwise return the value
none_throws_custom_message: throw a ValueError with a custom message when a value is None
none_throws_safe_unwrap: safely unwrap an optional value and raise ValueError if it is None
